turns.question: What was the median site session duration in minutes between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for site session duration (median or otherwise), so I can't give that figure; the closest metrics are Site sessions (site_sessions, sessions with a page view), Cart sessions (cart_sessions), Checkout sessions (checkout_sessions) and Customer actions (customer_actions), and I can query any of them for 20 September to 3 October 2026 if that helps.
